# Charly Vibes

> A field of experimentation for LLM-assisted development. All code is generated by large language models; the human contribution lies in requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Charly Vibes explores what software development looks like when the machine writes and the human decides. A growing set of repositories spanning CLI tools, SPAs, blogs, Android apps, specs, and desktop applications — all built through dialogue with AI.

## Projects

### The ecosystem

The CLIs and shared infrastructure that hold everything together: capture context, verify behavior, select tests, analyze code. Almost all Rust, plus a goldsmith in Go. Several are still in specification stage.

- [wai](https://charly-vibes.github.io/wai/): Gestor de flujos de trabajo para desarrollo asistido por IA.
- [fabbro](https://charly-vibes.github.io/fabbro/): Herramienta CLI para revisar y anotar código generado por LLMs. Local-first, sin servidores.
- [dont](https://charly-vibes.github.io/dont/): CLI para obligar a agentes a fundamentar sus afirmaciones. Primero el grounding, después el verbo.
- [espectacular](https://github.com/charly-vibes/espectacular): Capa de verificación de comportamiento para el ecosistema de desarrollo IA de charly.
- [testaruda](https://github.com/charly-vibes/testaruda): Motor de selección de tests con semiring de procedencia. Dado un cambio de código, computa los tests afectados.
- [pretender](https://github.com/charly-vibes/pretender): Análisis de código basado en tree-sitter que genera reportes SARIF.
- [vampiro](https://github.com/charly-vibes/vampiro): Rust CLI that checks whether code composes correctly across call, module, effect, law, retry, resource, and trust boundaries.
- [crua](https://github.com/charly-vibes/crua): Rust CLI, in specification stage, that checks whether code respects the raw hardware and runtime cost model it executes on — cache-line layout, type stability, concurrency models, lock/STM contention.
- [livin](https://github.com/charly-vibes/livin): Rust CLI, in specification stage, that checks whether a test suite actually exercises the boundary values a code's own shape implies: zero, empty, singleton, duplicate, overflow, every arm of a sum type.
- [genesis](https://charly-vibes.github.io/genesis/): Shared Rust crate of cross-cutting CLI/AIX/self-healing infrastructure for the charly-vibes tool suite — the common foundation the puzzle needed.
- [dulce-de-leche](https://github.com/charly-vibes/dulce-de-leche): One command to install, configure, and update every charly-vibes tool. Repo root stays clean — everything lives under `.ddl/`.

### The writing

What gets written while building: the logbook, the method, the recipe, and the ritual.

- [microdancing](https://charly-vibes.github.io/microdancing/llms.txt): Blog de microposts y crónicas de lo mínimo. Hogar del manifiesto del Resonant Coding.
- [rizomas](https://charly-vibes.github.io/rizomas/llms.txt): Ensayos interactivos rizomáticos sobre cómo funcionan los LLMs.
- [incitaciones](https://charly-vibes.github.io/incitaciones/llms.txt): Colección de prompts reutilizables y skills para herramientas CLI de LLMs.
- [canticos](https://charly-vibes.github.io/canticos/): Scripts de uso personal: conversión de video para proyector, transcripción con whisper, dashboard de Claude Code.

### The laboratory

Experiments without a master plan: web, mobile, and desktop apps, plus a few loose critters.



#### Web apps

- [atril](https://charly-vibes.github.io/atril/): Web viewers for the wai ecosystem. Comfortable reading of specs and issues.
- [jams](https://charly-vibes.github.io/jams/llms.txt): Small apps, one-day experiments, for understanding tools directly and almost brutally.
- [nayra](https://charly-vibes.github.io/nayra/llms.txt): Deep-time timeline visualization. 10,000+ events at 60 FPS, microseconds to billions of years.
- [superficies](https://github.com/charly-vibes/superficies): Design catalog for exploring orthogonal web-design dimensions via live preview.
- [tRAGar](https://github.com/charly-vibes/tRAGar): Client-side Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the browser using transformers.js.
- [miblioteca](https://github.com/charly-vibes/miblioteca): Bookshelf Spine Capture. TypeScript PWA for cataloging books from spine photos.

#### Mobile

- [paranoid](https://charly-vibes.github.io/paranoid/): Android app hosting many small native Kotlin mini-apps.

#### Desktop

- [fotos](https://charly-vibes.github.io/fotos/llms.txt): Screenshot tool with OCR, PII detection, and MCP server for code agent integration.

#### Other experiments

- [bichos](https://github.com/charly-vibes/bichos): Biomimetic framework for autonomous QA — swarms of specialized agents coordinated by stigmergy.
- [khipu](https://github.com/charly-vibes/khipu): Agent trace forensics and workflow crystallization.
- [ruta](https://github.com/charly-vibes/ruta): pi package for a disciplined seven-day spec-immersion workflow.
- [paseos](https://github.com/charly-vibes/paseos): A repo in gestation: no defined shape yet, just the authorship notice and an intention nobody knows how it will grow.

### Distribution

Package repositories for installing the tools: the Homebrew tap and the Scoop bucket. The dulce-de-leche CLI (ddl) automates what these repos expose.

- [homebrew-charly](https://github.com/charly-vibes/homebrew-charly): Tap de Homebrew para las herramientas de charly-vibes.
- [scoop-charly](https://github.com/charly-vibes/scoop-charly): Bucket de Scoop para las herramientas de charly-vibes.

## Authorship

All code in this organization was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review. The LLM writes. The human knows what it should say.

- [Authorship note](https://github.com/charly-vibes/charly-vibes): Full statement in Spanish on LLM authorship and human role.
